title: Edudiagno — AI Interview Platform
summary: Real-time AI-powered interview and assessment platform built during an internship at Technobeez. Shreyas developed ~80% of the system, including backend APIs, scoring logic, and AI-driven interview workflows.

title: NightOut Planner — AI Event Recommendation System
summary: AI-driven event and venue recommendation app with GPT-powered conversational mode, live data-fetching, and a modern React + FastAPI architecture. Built for the GUTS × SAS Scotland Hackathon.

title: Glasgow Snow Prediction — 35-Year Climate & ML Analysis
summary: 35-year climatology analysis using Open-Meteo archives to predict snow likelihood in Glasgow with Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and first-snow-date distribution modelling.

title: Twin Engine — Jet Engine Digital Twin (RUL Predictor)
summary: Digital twin dashboard for predicting Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of turbofan engines using NASA CMAPSS dataset. Includes confidence intervals, feature explanations, and a React interface.

title: JLR EV Launch Delay Impact Simulation
summary: Strategic simulation modelling EV launch delays for Jaguar Land Rover. Includes revenue impact, competitor substitution modelling, scenario analysis, and visualisation outputs.

title: YouTube AI Summarizer
summary: NLP-powered tool that extracts transcripts and generates structured summaries, chapter breakdowns, and key insights for long-form YouTube videos.
